title: rumohra quadrangularis
intro: Rumohra quadrangularis, commonly known as the Fishbone Fern or Rasp Leaf Fern, is a species of fern native to South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra quadrangularis are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential medicinal properties.
